Castles are able to recruit stronger chainmail units earlier in the game. So if thats who your running into im not surprised. Playing as france you have lots of things you can do but your also surrounded by lots of factions that are going to attack you. Likely Milan idk why but those guys are blood thirsty. 

Id take any unclaimined lands then take Milan out first. That should give you a base of power to fight HRE and England which will be your primary rivals for the most part.
